svg.title: A grid of 362 cells. The frames step through K = 5, 15, 50, 150, 500. Lost poles grow from 26 to 158, and recovered poles stay between 11 and 16.
svg.text: As more neurons go, top pruning breaks
Each cell is one of Qwen2.5-0.5B's 362 VERIFIED poles, nearest a gate first. Circles pass again after
failing on the instruct model, triangles fail after keeping, dark cells still fail.
Poles run left to right, then down: the nearest to a gate at the top left, the furthest at the bottom.
